name: Camp Runels
description_short: Girl Scout overnight camp on 300 wooded acres beside Little Island Pond in Pelham. Campers pick a session focus and also swim, boat, hike, shoot archery, climb ropes courses, do arts and cook out with their unit, sleeping in platform tents, yurts or cabins.
refund_policy_summary: Deposits are not refundable. For 2026, cancelling in writing before May 15 got a full refund less the deposit, and before June 5 a 50% refund less the deposit. No refunds after June 5 except case by case for medical or other emergencies.
special_needs_notes: The council says it can handle most special needs and diets. Families email customer care to set up a meeting with the camp team.
